title: Writing Task 1 - Map: City Changes
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe two maps showing how a coastal town changed between 1980 and 2020.

stimuli.title: Task 1: Coastal Town Development — 1980 vs 2020
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The maps below show the layout of a coastal town in 1980 and in 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Changes: The fishing harbour was replaced by a marina. Farmland to the north was converted to a residential estate. The town centre expanded eastward with a new shopping mall. A coastal road was built. The old lighthouse was preserved as a heritage site. A new hotel complex was built on the seafront.

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the two maps showing how the coastal town changed between 1980 and 2020.

keyFeatures: The harbour area underwent the most dramatic transformation, shifting from fishing to tourism
Agricultural land to the north was entirely replaced by housing
The town centre expanded significantly towards the east
Transport infrastructure improved with the addition of a coastal road
